lines.text: Quotes scattered across e-mail. Comparisons in spreadsheets. Decisions nobody can explain. And payment on trust.
Veil Procure turns that into one confidential workflow, on NEAR.
Picture a small studio hiring an accessibility auditor.
It wants competing quotes kept apart, rules everyone sees up front, and payment only when the work is delivered.
Here is that whole journey, recorded live on NEAR testnet.
Sign in with a one-time e-mail link, create your organisation, and bind your NEAR wallet with a signed message.
Veil Procure never holds your keys: every on-chain step is signed by you.
Describe the work, the deliverables and the budget.
Set hard requirements every quote must pass, and the weights that rank the rest.
Invite suppliers, and set a deadline.
Publishing freezes these rules and anchors their hash on NEAR testnet, so the criteria can't quietly change later.
Each supplier gets a private invitation that only their e-mail can accept.
They quote price, delivery and approach, attach a proposal, and seal the bid: a salted fingerprint of the quote is recorded on chain.
Until the deadline, the buyer sees nothing, and competitors can't even open the request.
After the chain-time deadline, the buyer closes bidding.
Every opened quote is recomputed against its fingerprint, so any change since sealing would be detected.
That proves integrity, not secrecy: quotes are encrypted at rest, and the platform holds the key.
First, the published rules: ineligible quotes are flagged, and eligible ones are ranked by the weights.
Then, if you ask, a private A.I. reviews the quotes.
Nothing is sent until the model's hardware attestation is verified through NEAR A.I. Cloud, and the signed response is checked on return.
The notes are advisory: the A.I. cannot award or move money.
The buyer awards the top quote and funds the escrow with exactly that amount: 1.2 testnet NEAR, from their own wallet.
The contract now holds the funds. It can only pay the awarded supplier, or return them to the buyer.
The supplier accepts, delivers, and anchors evidence of the work.
The buyer approves, and the contract pays the supplier: a real transaction anyone can verify on NEAR testnet.
A release by anyone else, or a second payout, is rejected by the contract itself.
And every step lands in a hash-chained audit trail.
Veil Procure. Private bids. Intelligent decisions. Payments under your control.
